scope: Exploratory development comparison; preserve all previous FANUC results
candidate_source: Frozen original candidates, seed 0, no perception or model retraining

planning.method: Deterministic Panda IK, sampled joint transit and straight approach/lift; no detour search

physics.robot_gravity: Isaac native high-PD gravity disabled; MuJoCo robot gravcomp=1

timing: Record host, engine, parallelism, startup, planning, per-task or batch wall time and simulation time separately; cached front-end times are inherited measurements, not new end-to-end latency
comparison_limit: Robot/control/workspace differ from FANUC; native Isaac USD and MuJoCo Menagerie collision/inertia assets may differ. Treat as platform comparison, not isolated physics-engine causality.
scheduling: NAS preferred. Unique task assignment recorded before dispatch; GPU jobs take the existing shared lock and check other compute processes; no unrelated workload interruption.
failure_policy: Keep algorithm failures and timeouts; no success-based retries. Infrastructure failures retain attempt IDs and require diagnosis before retry. Do not launch main physics before platform calibration passes.
